decisions.decision: Is R* always exposed in the pre-answer clue set?

alternatives.risk: item correctness becomes unverifiable against the pinned snapshot

decisions.decision: Separate grounding vocabulary for distractor-owned facts, and how the paper describes it

alternatives.option: separate vocabulary with the one-clause rule
alternatives.risk: containment cases misclassified as observed alternatives; pre-answer clues implicate a contrast the snapshot contradicts

decisions.recommended: separate names in code with the three frozen tests, plus SHARED_BY_CONTAINMENT and UNRESOLVED_SEMANTIC_INDEX_UNAVAILABLE and a granularity-risk annotation on every group; in the paper one observation rule applied in two roles (evidence levels on Answer facts; grounding on any exposed clue)

decisions.decision: Objective formulation (weighted sum vs constraints + lexicographic keys) and the key order
decisions.arch1_default: integer weighted sum, thirteen named weights, ce_weights/1.0.0-candidate, two weights swept
evidence: kernel ranking_key (14 fields, v1) and the six-key combination objective are lexicographic tuples (src/mcq_core.py lines 686-700)

03_journal2_algorithm_spec section 11: a lexicographic implementation is acceptable

ARCH-1 section 9.1 names weight tuning as its weakest point

alternatives.risk: 13-15 numbers to defend; full sensitivity infeasible; safety can be outbid
never trades a higher key for a lower one; the author must accept strict priority
one tolerance per opened level, each in its own unit
the kernel already uses keys for tier, label length, token count; weights unnecessary

decisions.recommended: constraints + epsilon-lexicographic with all epsilon_i = 0 by default, canonical order last, versioned objective with adjacent-swap ablations; candidate pre-answer order: balance, shared information, key diversity, fewer sentences, tier, tokens, canonical; candidate post-answer order: fewer ABSENCE_ONLY incidences, fewer risk-bearing groups, shared information, key diversity, fewer nodes, tier, tokens, canonical

decisions.decision: Universe bounding: strata, N_max and the stability threshold
